title: Menstrual products; availability.
bodyText:
(a) The department shall provide menstrual products free of charge to all students on all public school campuses.

(b) For the purposes of this section:

"Menstrual products" includes but is not limited to disposable menstrual pads and tampons.

"Public school campuses" includes all department of education schools and all public charter schools.
bodyHtml:
[§302A-452]  Menstrual products; availability.  (a)  The department shall provide menstrual products free of charge to all students on all public school campuses.

     (b)  For the purposes of this section:

     "Menstrual products" includes but is not limited to disposable menstrual pads and tampons.

     "Public school campuses" includes all department of education schools and all public charter schools. [L 2022, c 113, §2]
